result.title: LambdaLens: Auditing a Representation-Changing Hyperparameter in Graph Neighbor Embedding
result.summary: Changing a graph embedding parameter can change what the layout represents. In SG-t-SNE-$Π$, the rescaling parameter $λ$ changes the probability assigned to each neighbor before optimization begins. We introduce LambdaLens to trace that change from individual edges to the resulting layout. For nodes with at least two neighbors, we derive a normalized power path. When the original weights are unequal, the number of neighbors determines where the weights become uniform and where their ordering reverses. Near $λ=1$, the rate of change in each edge probability depends on its surprisal relative to the neighborhood entropy. To measure the geometric effect, we vary $λ$ while holding the input graph, initialization, random seed, and optimizer settings fixed. Across six graphs, some layouts continue to move as $λ$ increases, others stabilize early, and others barely move. PubMed has the widest relative spread in node degree, yet its layout changes little. On four datasets with class labels, four probes recover 98.48-100% of the best label-fidelity score on a 16-value grid, using 75% fewer evaluations. In a six-dataset comparison, SG-t-SNE-$Π$ attains the highest observed primary score on four datasets and ranks among the top three on all six. On Citeseer, four probes come close to the dense-grid optimum, yet PHATE better preserves class structure, making a change of embedding pipeline worth considering on that graph. ```

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LambdaLens，解析 SG-t-SNE-Π 中重标度参数 λ 如何从单条边概率的归一化幂路径传导到整体布局几何，并在固定其他条件、变换 λ 的设置下比较六张图的布局稳定性与标签保真度；同时用四个探针在 16 值网格上以更少评估逼近最优分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 图嵌入与 LVR 距离较远，但其「用少数探针审计一个改变表示的超参数如何影响表示所保留的任务相关信息」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 视觉状态的表示诊断、相似度来源与超参数敏感性分析。
